title: 10 min to Broadway, Free Parking, Firepit/Backyard
description:
Spacious 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath home!
Sleeps 12 comfortably 
Centrally located- only 10 minutes to Broadway!
Enjoy the backyard with firepit, outdoor table, and gas grill
Designed with a retro western vibe to fit groups, couples, bachelorettes or bachelor's during their trip to Nashville.
Large living room with smart TV, open to dining room with large table and fully stocked kitchen. 
Coffee bar with Keurig and coffee pot- including pods, grounds, creamer, and sugar.

The space
Retro Ride – Your Western Getaway 10 Minutes from Broadway 🤠✨

Welcome to Retro Ride, a retro-western dream just 10 minutes from Broadway! Whether you’re planning a girls’ trip, birthday weekend, family getaway, or Nashville celebration, this spacious home sleeps 12 guests comfortably with 4 bedrooms and 2.5 baths.

Step inside and you’ll find:
• Open-concept layout perfect for entertaining
• Retro western décor with bold personality
• Tons of natural light + photo-worthy moments
• Spacious kitchen + large dining area

Outside is where the magic happens:
• 🌿 Statement greenery wall for unforgettable photos
• ✨ String lights for that perfect Nashville glow
• 🔥 Cozy firepit for late-night hangs
• 🌅 Large outdoor deck with oversized dining table for group dinners

Spend your days on Broadway, then come home to your own private Nashville oasis.

Perfect for:
✔ Bachelorette trips
✔ Birthday weekends
✔ Girls’ getaways
✔ Group vacations

Saddle up — Retro Ride is ready for you 🤠

Guest access
The entire home is available for use. Please don't move the trashcans behind the gate.
